kind: Causal Ethereal NY midpoint-limit trade model; gross points, unresolved intrabar order explicitly ambiguous

configuration.entry: one pre-bar nearest correct-side fresh visible zone; midpoint rounded buy down/sell up to NQ tick; opening-price improvement modeled
configuration.priority: distance from previous close, yellow on ties, older formation, stable key
configuration.firstTouch: first band-contact candle only; unfilled midpoint consumes the first attempt; no retest trades
configuration.side: frozen beta support/buy or rho resistance/sell
configuration.positionLimit: one position; no same-minute re-entry after an exit
configuration.ambiguousPolicy: mark unresolved and block new entries for rest of that NY session
configuration.sessionExit: flatten at final NY RTH candle close; positive sub-target exits remain distinct from 130-point TP wins
configuration.stopExecution: stop crossing fills at level; observed opening gaps through stop fill at opening price and can exceed planned risk
configuration.costs: unspecified; no fees/slippage invented; results are gross points only
configuration.excursions: confirmed lower bounds only; unsequenced entry/exit-bar extrema are not claimed as exact held-trade MFE/MAE

targetWinRateBoundsAllEntered.meaning: extreme outcome bounds for entered trades; not confidence intervals or a complete account path
